# UI work

Before creating or changing a user-facing interface, read the repository-root `AGENTS.md` and `DESIGN.md`. For the OpsGate browser UI, also read `web/DESIGN.md`. The root `DESIGN.md` is the canonical Dripstatic Studios identity shared by SourceToMe, SourceInk, Static Swarm, Dripnote, and Ops Drift Gate.

Use the source palette and design grammar in that file rather than inventing a product-specific replacement. The DSS drip highlight is the green anchor for drip-derived surfaces. Pale green is reserved for occasional, explicitly approved transitions or highlights; it is not a default accent. Preserve each product's information hierarchy and task flow while expressing the shared brand.
